definitions.explanation: A meal packed in a box, typically containing rice and various side dishes. A key part of Japanese food culture.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}が{弁当|べんとう}を{作|つく}ってくれました。
examples.english: My mother made a bento for me.

examples.japanese: コンビニで{弁当|べんとう}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought a bento at the convenience store.

examples.japanese: {駅弁|えきべん}を{食|た}べながら{旅行|りょこう}しました。
examples.english: I traveled while eating a train station bento.

notes: 弁当 is a fundamental part of Japanese culture. お弁当 (with honorific お) is also common. 駅弁 (えきべん) are bentos sold at train stations, often featuring local specialties. キャラ弁 are character-themed bentos made for children.
